items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: George Wein come up on the bandstand and he was white as a sheet, he was so scared, and he told Duke not to play anymore.

ctx.x: And four guys got cut, too, we heard, you know. And George Wein come up on the bandstand and he was white as a sheet, he was so scared, and he told Duke not to play anymore. You know, he wanted Duke to stop, but he should have never tell Duke not to do nothing. You don't tell Ellington 'never.' If you don't want him to do anything, don't tell him not to do it. Tell him to do it, see.
